cable.cable_swap: swap cables: one brown two green
cable.combined: add multiple defects to the cable
cable.poke_insulation: add a poke in the insulation

screw.manipulated_front: a screw with a blunted tip
screw.scratch_head: add a scratch on the head of the screw
screw.thread_side: add a scratch on the thread side
screw.thread_top: add a scratch on the thread top

transistor.bent_lead: add bent or shorted leads to the transistor

leather.color: the leather has a color defect
leather.cut: add a cut to the surface of the leather
leather.glue: add a glue mark upon the leather

hazelnut.print: add white marks to the surface

pill.combined: add a hole and a chipped edge

tile.oil: add a chemical stain to the tile

wood.scratch: add surface abrasions or deep scratches

carpet.thread: add a thread on the surface

metal_nut.color: add colored marks on the surface
